about: The first-visit intro, built from docs/design/first-visit-intro.dc.html: five cards, shown once on the home page; replayed from the "Replay intro screens" link at the top of /about, and opened by "What is this?" on deep-linked pages. The same five items are listed at the bottom of /about. Each card has an eyebrow, one sentence (line), a visual and a status ('live' or 'coming'). Visuals: 'cover' (drawn in code), 'recipe' and 'record' (a published chapter 1 image with its real recipe), 'live' and 'planned' (drawn from the features list). Each feature has a status, 'live' or 'planned', which drives cards 4 and 5 and the About page; a feature goes live by changing one word here (npm run check:intro checks that a live feature links to a page that exists). The disclaimer is shown on card 1 and at the top of /about (principle 7).
model_drafted_note: Wording from the design board (Claude Design, model-drafted placeholder copy), adapted by the coding agent on Oct 7, 2026 so it says only what is true: the board's '[Author name]' and '[LICENCE NAME]' are filled in, and 'play the game' is moved to the planned list because the game is not on the main site yet. Earlier wording (v1) was drafted by the coding agent on Oct 6, 2026. Shown labelled as model-drafted until the owner edits it; set model_drafted to false, with edited_by_fid and edited_on, when they do.

cards.line: Snowmoon is a novel its author released under an open licence, inviting anyone to adapt it.
Build anything you like from it, as long as you show how you made it.
This app keeps that record for you, so working together is easy and your name stays on your work.
Today you can read, listen, save a passage and browse adaptation seeds.
Later you will be able to add characters, places and styles, pick favourites that carry into your work, and start adaptations.

features.label: Pick favourites that carry into your work
